english.title: Cause use of vehicle / trailer - rear registration mark not lit during darkness
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) caused **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to use on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), during the hours of darkness a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), when not every letter and number of the registration mark displayed on the back of

(A)_[the]_
(B)_[the trailer drawn by the]_
(C)_[the rearmost trailer drawn by the]_

vehicle was illuminated so as to be easily legible as prescribed by Regulation 9 of the Road Vehicles (Display of Registration Marks) Regulations 2001
english.legislation: Contrary to section 59(1) of the Vehicle Excise and Registration Act 1994.

english.notes:
(i) See also offence wordings: H639 and H779.
(ii) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(iii) Additional information may be included in the Statement of Facts specifying whether the lamp was blown, the wiring was loose or there was a poor battery, etc.
english.standardstatementoffacts:
At **(..SPECIFY TIME..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant caused **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to use on **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..) during the hours of darkness **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..). The whole registration mark displayed on the back of

(A)_[the]_
(B)_[the trailer drawn by the]_
(C)_[the rearmost trailer drawn by the]_

vehicle was not illuminated so that it was easily legible.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level two on the standard scale.
